title: z.discriminatedUnion type inference fails with optional discriminators
body:
When creating a discriminated union where one of the member types has an optional or undefined discriminator literal, z.infer<> degrades to `never` instead of narrowing properly in TypeScript 5.5.

### Steps to reproduce
```ts
const schema = z.discriminatedUnion('type', [
  z.object({ type: z.literal('a'), value: z.string() }),
  z.object({ type: z.undefined(), value: z.number() })
]);
type T = z.infer<typeof schema>; // inferred as never
```
Expected: Type narrows correctly.
author: ts_wizard

title: Add z.jwt() helper schema for validating JSON Web Tokens
body: It would be super helpful to have a built-in helper for validating JWT strings with header/payload/signature format regex checks, similar to z.string().email() or z.string().uuid().
